_comment: License notices for bundled packages whose npm tarball ships no license file. scripts/bundle-wp.mjs copies these into vendor/licenses/ and refuses to build if a bundled package has neither its own file nor an entry here.

@tannin/sprintf@1.3.4.source: LICENSE.md: https://github.com/aduth/tannin/blob/94834a72f322a16120296eda18fe5c016fdca506/LICENSE.md (tag @tannin/sprintf@1.3.4, the monorepo's license); README-license.md: the License section of the package's own README.md, which carries the copyright line.

hpq@1.4.0.source: The License section of the package's own README.md (copyright line and full MIT text). The upstream repository https://github.com/aduth/hpq has no license file at tag 1.4.0.

react-property@2.0.2.source: https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/9cdf8a99edcfd94d7420835ea663edca04237527/LICENSE. The package README says: "MIT. See license from original project", linking to React's LICENSE; the upstream repository https://github.com/remarkablemark/react-dom-core has no license file.

react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8.source: https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/7301c160fda44cb8cf2b9fdfde61efad35736196/LICENSE, the repository's first license file (added 2025-05-21, after the 2.3.8 release of 2024-12-15, which declared MIT in package.json and README).

requestidlecallback@0.3.0.source: Reconstructed: upstream https://github.com/aFarkas/requestIdleCallback (tag 0.3.0) ships no license text, only "license": "MIT" and "author": "Alexander Farkas <info@corrupt-system.de>" in package.json. This file is the standard MIT text with that author as the copyright holder.
